final: WITH event_type_averages AS (SELECT e.type, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_amount_minus_spent FROM budget AS b INNER JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount_minus_spent) AS overall_avg FROM event_type_averages) SELECT AVG(a.avg_remaining) AS avg_budget_remaining, AVG(a.avg_amount_minus_spent) AS avg_amount_minus_spent, AVG(a.avg_amount_minus_spent - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall FROM event_type_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_amount_minus_spent > o.overall_avg
